headline: Superbonus tax credits spread over ten years, Pescara architects raise the alarm: "Businesses and professionals at risk"
summary: Pescara architects' order warns that changing or repealing Article 37 of the 2027 Budget Law puts businesses and professionals at risk. A councillor said state rules cannot change after work has been carried out.
why: The Superbonus was an Italian tax credit scheme for building renovation. Changes to its terms directly affect construction firms, contractors and the professionals who certify the work.
